intent: Distinguish an untidy bag today from permanent self-labelling, observe one concrete pocket change and prepare a personally relevant achievable organising action.
picturePurpose: Two enlargable original bag scenes show materials moving into a front pocket. The action supports concrete language; appearance never establishes personality or permanent outcomes.

workshop.title: 说清今天的状态，选一个小改变
workshop.instruction: 先把今天的现状与永久评价分开，再放大看一种整理办法，最后选一个今天能开始的动作。用自己的两到四句说清，不要求照抄参考做法。

items.label: 今天很乱，不等于永远不会整理
items.prompt: 哪句只说明当前状态，没有把一次情况变成永久标签？
items.reason: 今天的书包状态与对整个人的评价已分开。再用自己的句子说明现状。
items.hint: 原题给出今天书包很乱；不能据此推断自己永远做不好，也不用假装书包其实很整齐。
items.material: 说2—4句英文。你的书包很乱，但不想给自己贴“永远不会整理”的标签。说明一个今天能做的小改变。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 现状与标签对照卡
composeBrief.hint: 比较today和never这类词，把事实范围说准确。
composeBrief.wrong: 今天的状态不能直接推出永远的能力；也不要为了积极表达而否认原题事实。

choices.label: My bag is perfectly tidy already.
The bag shows that I cannot learn to organise my things.
The bag needs some organising now; this does not settle what I can learn.

items.label: 放大看一个具体小改变
items.prompt: 两幅图中，哪幅把资料放在了前袋？
items.reason: 前袋的变化已看清。它是一种可行示例，不是每个人必须照做的唯一方法。
items.hint: 图片只示范摆放动作，不说明人的性格、以后会不会整理，也不能让我们猜这些资料哪天要用。
items.material: 说2—4句英文。你的书包很乱，但不想给自己贴“永远不会整理”的标签。说明一个今天能做的小改变。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeArt.alt: 虚构书包整理示例：左图资料都在主袋、前袋为空；右图珊瑚色与青绿色资料移入前袋，蓝色笔记本和两支笔仍在主袋。两个书包和肩带完整显示。
composeArt.caption: 图示一种小改变：把资料集中到前袋。是否明天要用，由自己的计划说明；不从封面猜用途，也不把图当成人格评价。

composeBrief.title: 看清动作，再说明用途
composeBrief.hint: 只比较图中确实可见的摆放位置。
composeBrief.wrong: 前袋是否有资料可以观察；只看这次摆放，不能断定整个书包以后都会整齐，也不能知道资料何时要用。

fields.label: 哪幅前袋已经放了资料？

choices.label: Left: the front pocket is empty.
Right: some materials are together in the front pocket.

fields.label: 哪句只描述可见的小改变？

choices.label: The pocket change means the whole bag will now stay tidy.
Some materials have been put together in the front pocket.
The materials in the front pocket must all be for tomorrow.

items.label: 选一个今天能开始的动作
items.prompt: 选择一种示例动作，再接上相应的具体做法。自己的合理办法也可以不同。
items.reason: 所选动作与具体做法已对应。再把今天的状态和一个小改变连成自己的两到四句。
items.hint: 把明天要用的资料放在一起、把散落的笔收进笔袋，都只是可选示例。无需许诺以后再也不会乱。
items.material: 说2—4句英文。你的书包很乱，但不想给自己贴“永远不会整理”的标签。说明一个今天能做的小改变。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 小改变行动卡
composeBrief.hint: 动作要具体、今天可开始；目标不必一次解决全部问题。
composeBrief.wrong: 动作与做法要对应；只说以后尽量整齐，仍没有说明今天先做什么。自己的其他合理小改变也可以，不必照抄这两个示例。

choices.label: 把明天用的资料放到一起
I can put tomorrow’s materials together in one pocket today.
I can collect the loose pencils and put them in my pencil case today.
I will try to keep my bag tidier from now on.
Say two to four sentences about the current state and one small change.
Repeat that I will always be unable to organise things.
Say only bag and untidy without a complete thought.

transfer.stem: Which outline distinguishes the current state from a permanent label and proposes a concrete change?
transfer.passage:
A different small change
Your desk is untidy today. Say two to four English sentences that describe the current state without labelling yourself as someone who can never organise things. Explain one small desk-organising action you can start today. For example, you may collect tomorrow’s worksheets in one tray, but another relevant, achievable action is also allowed. Do not claim that the desk is already tidy or promise that it will stay perfect forever.

options.text: Explain that my desk is untidy today and suggest putting worksheets into one tray, but describe the current mess as evidence that I can never learn to organise things.
Explain that my desk is untidy today without a permanent label, then describe putting the worksheets for tomorrow into one tray as a small action I can start now.
Explain that my schoolbag is untidy today without a permanent label, then describe putting tomorrow’s materials in one pocket, keeping the earlier object instead of the desk.
Explain that my desk is already tidy without changing anything, then discuss the benefit of neatness in two to four sentences despite the given untidy state.

answer.display: Explain that my desk is untidy today without a permanent label, then describe putting the worksheets for tomorrow into one tray as a small action I can start now.

explanation.strategy: 先说这次真实状态，再给出一个可开始的动作。

steps.text: 这次是今天桌面很乱，不是永远不会整理。
steps.reason: 不能沿用书包情境，也不能把一次状态变成对整个人的永久评价。

steps.text: 可以把明天的练习纸收进一个托盘，也可以提出别的可行小动作。
steps.reason: 关键是具体、今天能开始；不要求照抄示例，也不保证以后永远完美。

distractors.reason: 把一次桌面状态夸大成永久能力判断。
仍在说旧书包，没有回应桌面和新的具体动作。
否认题目给出的现状，还漏掉了具体小改变。

explanation.pitfall: 只用积极口号否认现状，或把今天的困难当成永远的标签。
